Unspoken silence,
but on stage,
it's the strongest lobbyist.
Flow as you wish,
and words that hit your heart.
"Reticence is my weapon, but only for you I will remove the defence."
Bezlya Calla SpicyPuff, Bionic 2.2CF series 155cm M ver
